welcome_prompt: Select an action from the menu below:
waiting_admin_body: The bot is not configured yet. Your Telegram ID: %s Assign you as administrator?
help_lines:
/start — Main menu
/help — This help
/status — Quick status
/logs — Latest logs
/lang — Change language
/addadmin ID — Add admin
/deladmin ID — Remove admin

Use the menu buttons for other operations.
share_body: Send this link to your client:
remove_warn: ⚠️ This will stop and remove telemt, nginx site and configs. Continue?
admins_empty: Empty — the bot is locked and waiting for its first administrator
cg_ask_url: Send me the HTTPS git URL of a static site repository. Optionally append @branch.
cg_invalid: ❌ Invalid URL. Only HTTPS git URLs are allowed.
cg_timeout: ❌ Clone timeout (repository too large or slow)
warp_desc: Outbound traffic to Telegram data centers goes through Cloudflare: Telegram sees their address. Clients still reach :443 at your own IP.
warp_busy: ⏳ Another operation is still running — wait a couple of seconds.
warp_ask_key: 🔑 Send your WARP+ key as XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX in one message. Or the free key works without input — just "Enable (free)".
warp_key_badfmt: ❌ Invalid WARP+ key format (expected XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). Open the WARP menu and try again.
warp_ping_line: 📡 Telegram ping via WARP: %s ms · loss %s%%
action_busy_body: Wait for the previous action to finish and try again.
internal_error: ⚠️ Internal error. Please try again or send /start.
admin_claim_window: ⏳ The initial setup window stays open for about %s more min.
admin_claim_expired: ⛔ The initial setup window is closed (%s min after start). Add your Telegram ID to ALLOWED_IDS in /opt/gotelegram-bot/.env and restart the bot: systemctl restart gotelegram-bot Or just restart the bot and press /start within that window.
admin_claim_not_yours: This button is not for you
admin_already_set: ℹ️ An administrator is already assigned.
admins_hint: Total: %s Add an admin: /addadmin 123456789 Remove an admin: /deladmin 123456789 Ask @userinfobot for your own ID.
update_via_cli: Run the update from the console: gotelegram → 3) Management → 3) Update telemt
remove_ssh_only: The bot does not remove the installation: only the SSH menu can tear everything down (service, configs with secrets, nginx, certificates, backups, bot and web admin) — it asks for confirmation and removes things in the right order. Run on the server:
backup_contents: A backup includes: telemt config, goTelegram settings, keys, disabled keys, site, templates, SSL, bot, web admin and traffic history.
restore_corrupt: ❌ Archive %s is corrupt (tar -tzf fails). Restore cancelled — pick another backup.
restore_confirm_fmt: Restore %s? A fresh safety backup will be created before restoring.
restore_started_fmt: ✅ Restore of %s started in the background. Services may restart — check status in about a minute.
restore_already_running: ⏳ A restore is already running. Wait for it to finish.
restore_encrypted_cli: ❌ Encrypted backups are restored from the console: gotelegram → Management → Restore.
users_hint: Tap a key to see its link, stats and actions.
user_api_unavailable: Runtime API is unavailable. Fresh goTelegram Pro installs enable it automatically.
user_disabled_note: The key is disabled and is not accepted by telemt right now.
user_history_empty: No traffic history for this key yet.
user_add_prompt: Send a user name: latin letters, digits, _ . -, up to 48 characters. Example: ivan or family-1.
user_add_bad_name: ❌ Invalid name. Use latin letters, digits, _ . - and up to 48 characters.
user_state_save_failed: ❌ Failed to save the key state
user_config_busy: ⏳ The config is busy with another operation — try again in a couple of seconds.
user_iplimit_prompt: Current value: %s Send a number: 0 removes the personal limit, 2 or more sets how many addresses are allowed at once. One is not allowed: a phone changes its address when switching Wi-Fi to LTE and would be cut off.
user_toggle_main: The main key cannot be disabled
user_del_main: The main key cannot be deleted
adpi_order: Higher means higher priority and steadier operation.
kbd_cleanup: 🧹 Removed the keyboard left over from a previous bot on this token.
website_only_pro: Website management is available in pro mode only.
change_only_pro: Template change is available in pro mode only.
adpi_v4_warn: V4 is marked experimental by its own author. Verify iOS, Android and desktop.
user_iplimit_min_err: A limit of one address breaks an ordinary phone: switching Wi-Fi to LTE changes the address while the old connections are still alive, and the client hits the ceiling. Measured on a live server: about 20 seconds without service on average, up to 6 minutes at worst. The minimum is 2. Zero removes the personal limit.
rkb_on: ⌨️ Keyboard enabled. Buttons are below the input field. Hide it with /keyboard
rkb_off: ⌨️ Keyboard hidden. Bring it back with /keyboard
rkb_menu_title:
🤖 MTProxy control bot
Pick an action from the menu below:
users_export_file: All keys: %s. Name, state, secret and link — one per line.
users_export_failed: ⚠️ Could not send the keys file.
users_export_qr_capped: QR codes drawn for the first %s keys. The other %s are in the file above — too many for an album.
users_export_no_qr: ⚠️ QR codes skipped: qrencode is not installed on the server. Links are in the file above.
sec_service_hint: Things you do by hand once in a while.
sec_settings_hint: Set once: mode, website, access, language.
sub_panel_on: The panel is published on your domain. Sign in with a code from this bot; the path is secret — do not share it.
sub_panel_off: The panel runs on the server only. Enable the Mini App to open it from outside.
ma_security: Served at a secret path. You get in either with a Telegram signature (the button in this bot) or with a code from this chat — nothing else.
ma_hint: The address is secret: do not publish it. Rotating it breaks the old link.
ma_need_pro: Pro mode with your own domain is required — the app is served from it.
ma_need_bot: Install the Telegram bot first: the button appears there.
ma_enabled: Mini App enabled. The button will appear in the bot.
ma_nginx_bad: nginx rejected the config — Mini App not enabled, site untouched.
ma_rotate_warn: The old address stops working immediately. Anyone you gave it to has to reopen the panel from this bot.
ma_howto: How to sign in: open the address in a browser → “Send code” → the code arrives in the Telegram bot. Inside Telegram the same panel opens with the button, no code needed.
edge_nodata: No data yet — collection is running, the picture appears in a few minutes.
edge_hint: Traffic per address over 15 minutes, an hour and a day. ✓ the address answers on your domain, ✗ it does not.
web_link_hint: The client will warn that a web proxy runs the provider's page in the background — that is Telegram's standard notice.
web_desc: MTProxy inside plain HTTPS to your domain: to the network it is a website visit. Every key gets a second link with the same secret.
web_block_need_pro: Available only in Pro mode with a domain.
web_block_need_core: Requires telemt {v} or newer — update the core in Service.
web_block_need_cert: No Let's Encrypt certificate for the domain.
web_status_failed: could not read the state — try refreshing
web_block_need_addr: Could not determine the server's public IPv4 — WEB proxy cannot be built without it.
web_block_need_web_host: WEB needs a separate name (e.g. www.your-domain): on the main domain WEB disrupts regular links behind the same Wi-Fi. Set it with the "🌐 Separate WEB name" button.
web_block_need_no_shared443: WEB on a separate name is incompatible with shared 443 (shared-443 with 3x-ui) — remove it in the SSH menu first.
web_legacy_warn: WEB runs on the main domain and disrupts regular links behind the same Wi-Fi — set a separate name ("🌐 Separate WEB name") and hand out new WEB links.
web_host_ask: 🌐 Send the separate name for WEB in one message — a subdomain of your domain (one level below it), e.g. www.{d}, with an A record to this server. The DNS check and certificate issuance take a few minutes.
web_host_not_sub: ❌ The WEB name must be a subdomain of your domain {d} — e.g. www.{d}. Send the name again.
dns_missing_one: Address {ips} is not in the DNS of {name} — clients using a link to {name} will not reach it; add an A record. If the address is kept as an SSH backup, that is intended.
dns_missing_many: Addresses {ips} are not in the DNS of {name} — clients using a link to {name} will not reach them; add A records. If the addresses are kept as SSH backups, that is intended.
edge_dns_legend: DNS — the address is in the domain's A records, WEB — in the WEB name's A records (✓ yes, ✗ no).
web_host_badfmt: ❌ This does not look like a domain name: no spaces, only Latin letters, digits, dots and hyphens, up to 253 characters. Send the name again.
web_host_applying: ⏳ Checking DNS and expanding the certificate — up to two minutes…
web_carrier_ios: Telegram for iPhone supports only the https carrier — with this carrier WEB will not connect on iPhone.
web_result_unknown: ⏳ No answer from the installer — the operation may still be running. Check the WEB state in a minute.
web_host_legacy_warn: WEB currently runs on the main domain. After the name change the old WEB links stop working and the proxy reconnects for a few seconds — hand out the new WEB links to everyone.
tpl_err_no_index: this template has no ready index.html page — the repository holds build sources, not a site
tpl_err_download_failed: the repository could not be downloaded — unavailable or no connection to GitHub from the server
tpl_err_app_shell: the page is an empty application shell — the browser would show a blank screen
tpl_err_broken_assets: the page references styles and scripts missing from the repository — the site would render bare
